normalized.result:
This model feels right. Active should be the default view, and archived bookmarks should not appear in its list or search results; searching while in Archived should search only the archive.

Direct deletion from either view is fine as long as it always clearly warns that deletion is permanent and allows me to cancel. Archive should remain reversible indefinitely. Keeping View separate from the read/unread filter also makes sense, so I’m satisfied with archive versus delete.
